title: Efficient SAT-Based Bounded Model Checking of Evolving Systems
problem: Current SAT-based verification tools reverify systems from scratch after design modifications, even when changes are small. This wastes computation since prior verification results could inform later verification rounds.
motivation: Systems are rarely designed in a single step; designers repeatedly make small modifications and reverify. Naive reverification from scratch is inefficient and time-consuming.
method: Proposes a novel SAT-based verification technique that reuses information learned during verification of earlier system versions to speed up verification of later versions. Implemented in PrediCore, a bounded model checker for SystemVerilog, applied to RISC-V cores.
key_novelty: Incremental SAT-based verification that reuses learned clauses and constraints across successive system versions, avoiding redundant verification work.
contributions: PrediCore tool for incremental bounded model checking
Significantly improved verification time on later system versions
Benchmark set based on real edit history for open-source RISC-V cores (now publicly available)
primary_theme: Incremental SAT-based verification for evolving system designs
